DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma.

Your constellation of symptoms—specifically the "B" symptoms (night sweats, weight loss) combined with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy in a smoker—is classic for lymphoma, though lung cancer with metastatic spread remains a differential. The imaging I just requested should clarify the extent of involvement; pending those results, I have determined the most likely diagnosis based on the clinical presentation.
